question: Why does Sanjaya rejoice repeatedly while remembering the dialogue?
premises: He remembers again and again the wondrous dialogue of Kesava and Arjuna.
inference: Repeated remembrance of the divine dialogue produces repeated joy.
uncertainties: The fused compound is kept as one row.
plain_english: O king, remembering again and again the wondrous, meritorious dialogue of Kesava and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.
